description: A 100 m uncertainty-aware dataset of rooftop rainwater harvesting potential for South Asia derived from building footprints, remote sensing, and probabilistic rainfall modelling A 100 m uncertainty-aware dataset of rooft is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors MUHAMMAD USMAN KHAN (Beihang University). Dataset Files SummaryThis repository provides a set of geospatial datasets for rainfall analysis and rooftop rainwater harvesting. Annual CHIRPS precipitation grids (1981–2025) are used as the climate input. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 53542722427 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
